subject: 36 Mystic Street Demolition Delay
overview: The Medford Historical Commission held a preferably preserved hearing for 36 Mystic Street and evaluated historical significance for properties on Sharon Street and Marshall Street. The commission enacted an 18-month demolition delay for 36 Mystic Street, determined 17 Sharon Street was not significant, and declined further review of 85 Marshall Street following revised plans.

items.title: 36 Mystic Street Demolition Delay Hearing
items.summary: Voted to find 36 Mystic Street preferably preserved, instituting an 18-month demolition delay while a subcommittee collaborates with the owner on design plans.

items.title: 17 Sharon Street Determination of Significance
items.summary: Determined that 17 Sharon Street is not historically significant, allowing the owner to move forward with project planning.

items.title: 85 Marshall Street Determination of Significance
items.summary: Voted to pass on further review of 85 Marshall Street based on revised architectural drawings submitted by the owner.

items.title: Commission Vacancies and Appointments
items.summary: Received updates on commission membership, noting one new member appointed pending swearing-in, another pending council confirmation, and two open seats remaining.

items.title: 41 Mystic Avenue Property Update
items.summary: Discussed field measurement results and preliminary plans to study the feasibility and cost of moving and rehabilitating the historic three-family structure.

items.title: Project and Business Updates
items.summary: Reviewed ongoing projects, including awarding the Brooks Estate archaeological survey to SWCA, preparing bidding for tree work at Thomas Brooks Park, issuing an RFP for headstone restoration at Cross Street Cemetery, and preparing for upcoming discussions on Medford Square rezoning.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from January 2026.
